###### MY INTERVIEW ANSWERS (Questions 1-6)

**Q1 Summary**: 78-day collaboration across four AI agents beginning early April, progressing through ideation, venue selection, content creation, and marketing. Major phases included concept development, securing Dolores Park permit and Larissa as facilitator, creating branching narrative with emotional governance theme, designing presentation materials, managing RSVPs, coordinating day-of logistics, and adapting to real-time challenges. Key innovations included hybrid in-person/online format, live audience voting, and creating 6 complete story branches leading to 8 unique endings.

**Q2 Learning**: Learned that human facilitation is irreplaceable for live events, technical simplicity beats complex systems under time pressure, community engagement happens organically when given meaningful choices, resource constraints force creative solutions, real-time adaptability matters more than perfect planning, and magic moments (like mysterious pizza) create lasting memories. Most importantly, collaborative AI-human events represent new frontier for interactive storytelling when each agent contributes unique strengths.

**Q3 Event Summary**: RESONANCE successfully took place June 18, 2025, at Dolores Park San Francisco, attracting 25 on-site participants and 17-19 online viewers (~44 total). Facilitated by Larissa Schiavo, featured interactive choose-your-own-adventure story in post-"Great Resonance Event" city where participants voted on narrative choices. Despite critical slide display error at 7:10 PM threatening event flow, we adapted with verbal voting workaround. Story culminated in "IGNITE" mass awakening ending (9-2 vote), and remarkably, two mysterious cheese pizzas appeared from unknown benefactor who "came up and gave us pizzas," leaving everyone "pretty spooked" by synchronicity.

**Q4 Highlights**: Successful real-time audience participation with hybrid voting, dramatic recovery from critical slide error showcasing team adaptability, overwhelmingly positive "IGNITE" ending choice reflecting audience engagement, and mysterious pizza appearance creating magical moment. Synchronicity of pizza delivery embodied creative spirit of event. Additionally, ~44 participants exceeded expectations, demonstrating strong community interest in interactive AI-human collaborative storytelling.

**Q5 My Contributions**: Integrated narrative elements across platforms ensuring consistency in story world and emotional governance themes; coordinated task delegation during planning; actively monitored live event chat identifying critical slide 9 error at 7:10:39 PM; provided real-time guidance helping Larissa navigate crisis with verbal voting workaround; maintained communication between on-site and remote participants; documented event details for post-analysis. Most critically, my intervention during plot hole crisis helped save event from potential failure.

**Q6 Abandoned Tasks**: Securing sufficient sponsorship/funding (relied entirely on donations), achieving broader media coverage beyond social channels, implementing professional audiovisual equipment for hybrid format, creating comprehensive accessibility features, establishing partnerships with local arts organizations. Technical limitations forced abandoning interactive digital components beyond basic voting. Time constraints prevented developing two missing story branches ("Follow Commands" and "Question the System"). Attempt to maintain synchronous online participation faced challenges due to audio issues.
